readingbetweenthelines.name: Reading Between the Lines
readingbetweenthelines.slogan: A church drawn in steel lines, vanishing as you walk around it.
readingbetweenthelines.line: Designed in 2011 by Gijs Van Vaerenbergh, it is built from stacked steel layers and seems to dissolve in the Borgloon fields depending on your angle.

cmine.name: C-mine
cmine.slogan: A coal mine that went quiet and came back as a creative hub.
cmine.line: The Winterslag mine closed in 1988; Genk bought the site in 2001 and the name C-mine was inaugurated in 2005.

quintinustoren.name: Sint-Quintinus Cathedral
quintinustoren.slogan: Hasselt's old parish tower, now watching over a bishop's seat.
quintinustoren.line: Begun in the 11th century, the church only became a cathedral in 1967, when the Diocese of Hasselt was created.

jenevermuseum.name: National Jenever Museum
jenevermuseum.slogan: Juniper spirit, poured where the city has always distilled it.
jenevermuseum.line: The distillery site still has its malt tower, boiling room and an ox stable, because the oxen ate the distilling by-product.

fietsendoorwater.name: Cycling Through Water
fietsendoorwater.slogan: Pedal through a pond with the water lapping at eye level.
fietsendoorwater.line: Opened in 2016, the 212-metre path splits a pond in the Bokrijk wetlands, its walls just above the waterline.
